Apparently, this particular [DEFEAT1] carries a [DEFEAT1ACQUIRE1]; an item which would assist me greatly in my work. I am willing to offer a generous reward if you can recover the [DEFEAT1ACQUIRE1] for me.
Quests.translation: Você parece um indivíduo empreendedor... Talvez eu possa interessá-lo em uma pequena oportunidade de negócios.\n\nSoube de um espécime de [DEFEAT1] particularmente desagradável no andar [DEPTH]. Aparentemente, este [DEFEAT1] em especial carrega um [DEFEAT1ACQUIRE1]; um item que me ajudaria muito no meu trabalho. Estou disposto a oferecer uma recompensa generosa se você puder recuperar o [DEFEAT1ACQUIRE1] para mim.

Quests.original:
I have defeated Ordrak, but his darkness still infests the Ember here.  Can he truly be dead while his spirit runs through the veins?

This is not the end of the evils below Torchlight.  I have grown stronger here, but the corruption of our age boils just beneath the surface.  I must continue to hone my skills.

I will remain awhile in Torchlight and await the conflict yet to come.
Quests.translation:
Eu derrotei Ordrak, mas sua escuridão ainda infesta o Âmbar aqui. Ele pode estar verdadeiramente morto enquanto seu espírito corre pelos veios?

Este não é o fim dos males abaixo de Torchlight. Fiquei mais forte aqui, mas a corrupção de nossa era borbulha logo abaixo da superfície. Devo continuar aprimorando minhas habilidades.

Permanecerei um pouco em Torchlight e aguardarei o conflito que há de vir.

Quests.original: Destroying evil is its own reward, but I think I have earned a promotion for this victory.  Although the Vanquishers are a secret order, my king will hear that I was responsible for Ordrak's defeat. \n\nSoon I will return home, but there are still treasures below Torchlight that could aid us in the battles to come.  I sense a tide of darkness will soon be upon us, I will be prepared to meet it.
Quests.translation: Destruir o mal é sua própria recompensa, mas acho que mereço uma promoção por esta vitória. Embora as Vingadoras sejam uma ordem secreta, meu rei ouvirá que fui responsável pela derrota de Ordrak.\n\nEm breve retornarei para casa, mas ainda há tesouros abaixo de Torchlight que podem nos ajudar nas batalhas que virão. Sinto que uma maré de escuridão logo estará sobre nós; estarei preparada para enfrentá-la.

Quests.original: It's no wonder Master Alric sent for my help, the Ember mines are overrun with these creatures. His letter was urgent, but I had no idea how dire things had become.\n\nI am Syl, and that was my companion, Brink.  We've only just arrived in Torchlight, and it looks like we're going to need some help.  You look capable, and I can pay you well.  Please, catch up to Brink before he gets himself killed.
Quests.translation: Não é à toa que o Mestre Alric pediu minha ajuda; as minas de Âmbar estão infestadas por essas criaturas. A carta dele era urgente, mas eu não fazia ideia de quão graves as coisas haviam se tornado.\n\nEu sou Syl, e aquele era meu companheiro, Brink. Acabamos de chegar a Torchlight e parece que vamos precisar de ajuda. Você parece capaz, e posso pagar bem. Por favor, alcance Brink antes que ele acabe morto.

Quests.original: Ember is the essence of magic, and it assumes aspects of its environment.  That is why Ember from different locations can appear and behave completely differently.\n\nI've heard of a vast |cFFFFBA00necropolis|u buried below the mines.  |cFFFFBA00Deathlace Ember|u can sometimes be found in such places.  Studying such a rare type of Ember is a long held dream of mine.  You'll bring me any you find won't you?
Quests.translation: O Âmbar é a essência da magia e assume aspectos de seu ambiente. É por isso que o Âmbar de diferentes locais pode parecer e se comportar de forma completamente diferente.\n\nOuvi falar de uma vasta |cFFFFBA00necrópole|u enterrada abaixo das minas. O |cFFFFBA00Âmbar da Renda da Morte|u às vezes pode ser encontrado em tais lugares. Estudar um tipo tão raro de Âmbar é um sonho antigo meu. Você me trará qualquer um que encontrar, não trará?

Quests.original: This shall be my greatest ballad!  It's true that none of my songs have met with their deserved acclaim so far, but this one shall be different.\n\n|cFFFFBA00[DEFEAT1]|u has been terrorizing Torchlight since the first miners arrived, slinking up from its lair |cFFFFBA00[DEFEAT1DEPTH]|u floors below the town.  They will rejoice to hear of its defeat, and it should give them a new appreciation for my talent.
Quests.translation: Esta será a minha maior balada! É verdade que nenhuma das minhas canções obteve o merecido aclamação até agora, mas esta será diferente.\n\n|cFFFFBA00[DEFEAT1]|u tem aterrorizado Torchlight desde que os primeiros mineradores chegaram, rastejando para fora de seu covil |cFFFFBA00[DEFEAT1DEPTH]|u andares abaixo da cidade. Eles se alegrarão ao saber de sua derrota, e isso deverá lhes dar uma nova apreciação pelo meu talento.

Quests.original:
The disturbances in Torchlight were more severe than I'd expected - though I must admit I felt a bit relieved. Petty assignments often signal the end of a Vanquisher's career.

I came to restore the flow of Ember - but the darkness below Torchlight ran far deeper than the mines.

It would be a test of both my skill and conviction. Evil must be torn out at its root, and this one had buried itself deeply.
Quests.translation:
Os distúrbios em Torchlight eram mais graves do que eu esperava — embora deva admitir que me senti um pouco aliviada. Tarefas insignificantes costumam sinalizar o fim da carreira de uma Vingadora.

Vim para restaurar o fluxo de Âmbar — mas a escuridão abaixo de Torchlight ia muito mais fundo do que as minas.

Seria um teste tanto da minha habilidade quanto da minha convicção. O mal deve ser arrancado pela raiz, e este havia se enterrado profundamente.

Quests.original: The council has ordered the necropolis sealed.  I could purge the corruption from the awakened with a little more time, but they will not listen!  They call the Ember's effect a curse and feign concern for the peaceful rest of our ancestors, but fear alone guides them!\n\nIf the council refuses to accept the blessing of eternal life, we will keep the Ember for ourselves.  Woe to any who disturb our sanctuary.
Quests.translation: O conselho ordenou que a necrópole fosse selada. Eu poderia purificar a corrupção dos despertos com um pouco mais de tempo, mas eles não querem ouvir! Chamam o efeito do Âmbar de maldição e fingem preocupação com o descanso pacífico dos nossos ancestrais, mas é apenas o medo que os guia!\n\nSe o conselho se recusa a aceitar a bênção da vida eterna, guardaremos o Âmbar para nós mesmos. Ai de quem perturbar nosso santuário.

Quests.original:
It has been a long journey for you - if you wish, you may |cFFFFBA00Retire.|u Be forewarned, retirement is permanent.

Upon retiring, you may pass down one of your items as an |cFFFFBA00Heirloom|u to your descendent, and it will be further enhanced.  Your descendent will receive the benefit of your Fame, and begin their own journey with increased skill.

Come speak to me again when you wish to |cFFFFBA00Retire.|u
Quests.translation:
Foi uma longa jornada para você — se desejar, você pode se |cFFFFBA00Aposentar.|u Fique avisado, a aposentadoria é permanente.

Ao se aposentar, você pode legar um de seus itens como uma |cFFFFBA00Herança de Família|u para seu descendente, e ele será ainda mais aprimorado. Seu descendente receberá os benefícios da sua Fama e iniciará sua própria jornada com habilidades aumentadas.

Venha falar comigo novamente quando desejar se |cFFFFBA00Aposentar.|u

Quests.original: The deepest Ember will show the most signs of corruption.  It will contain the blight in its purest form.  It will be a terrible thing to behold, but my research would be incomplete without an example of Sanguine Ember.\n\nI cannot blame you if you don't wish to search for it; I'm certainly not fool enough to tread so close to the source.  Still, if you stumble upon such a foul thing, why not be rewarded for your efforts?
Quests.translation: O Âmbar mais profundo apresentará os maiores sinais de corrupção. Conterá a praga em sua forma mais pura. Será algo terrível de se contemplar, mas minha pesquisa estaria incompleta sem um exemplo de Âmbar Sanguíneo.\n\nNão posso culpá-lo se não desejar procurar por ele; certamente não sou tolo o bastante para andar tão perto da fonte. Ainda assim, se você se deparar com algo tão vil, por que não ser recompensado pelos seus esforços?

Quests.original:
You say this is Alric's doing?  Then his summons was a trap - but why?

The corruption here must have overwhelmed his mind, I can't believe it's so powerful.

Yes, yes... I see it's touched you as well.  Blight is spreading through you, and if we don't find a way to stop it you'll meet the same fate as Brink.  I'm sorry I brought you into this, I'll do my best to cure you.  Meet me in Torchlight, and I'll tell you my plan.
Quests.translation:
Você diz que isso é obra de Alric? Então o chamado dele era uma armadilha — mas por quê?

A corrupção aqui deve ter dominado a mente dele, não posso acreditar que seja tão poderosa.

Sim, sim... vejo que tocou você também. A praga está se espalhando por você e, se não encontrarmos uma forma de detê-la, você terá o mesmo destino de Brink. Sinto muito por tê-lo colocado nisso; farei o meu melhor para curá-lo. Encontre-me em Torchlight e contarei meu plano.

Quests.original:
It is no wonder the Estherians' knowledge advanced so quickly, they were perched atop an endless supply of Ember!

We will need all three of the missing destination glyphs.  The Estherians must have hidden them in the ruins to seal off the corruption below.  I expect one is hidden through each of the active rune gates.

We must not waste time.  So far Ember Blight has only made you stronger, but eventually it will control you.
Quests.translation:
Não é de admirar que o conhecimento dos esterianos tenha avançado tão rápido; eles estavam estabelecidos sobre uma fonte infinita de Âmbar!

Precisaremos de todos os três glifos de destino que estão faltando. Os esterianos devem tê-los escondido nas ruínas para isolar a corrupção abaixo. Suponho que haja um escondido através de cada um dos portais rúnicos ativos.

Não devemos perder tempo. Até agora a Praga de Âmbar apenas tornou você mais forte, mas eventualmente ela o controlará.

Quests.original: The Savage Ember is sometimes found near molten rock, look for it there.  I will of course reward you for any samples you find.\n\nI'm troubled by the results of my research so far.  It seems that all of the Ember Veins are being influenced by a single source, something far below the mountain.  I will require deeper samples to learn more about the nature of the impurities, but there is something menacing about what I've found so far.
Quests.translation: O Âmbar Selvagem às vezes é encontrado perto de rocha fundida; procure por ele lá. Eu, é claro, recompensarei você por quaisquer amostras que encontrar.\n\nEstou inquieto com os resultados da minha pesquisa até agora. Parece que todos os veios de Âmbar estão sendo influenciados por uma única fonte, algo muito abaixo da montanha. Vou precisar de amostras mais profundas para saber mais sobre a natureza das impurezas, mas há algo ameaçador no que encontrei até o momento.

Quests.original:
Were you drawn here by the lure of Ember?  Perhaps my master was as well.

Master Alric called me here, but there is no sign of him in town.  These creatures ambushed us as we were about to enter the mines.  They may have ambushed Alric as well, but I doubt it- he would not be overcome so easily.

I need time to question the townsfolk and recover from battle.  Brink has been with me for a long time now- please, watch over him for me.
Quests.translation:
Você foi atraído até aqui pelo fascínio do Âmbar? Talvez meu mestre também tenha sido.

O Mestre Alric me chamou aqui, mas não há sinal dele na cidade. Estas criaturas nos emboscaram quando estávamos prestes a entrar nas minas. Elas podem ter emboscado Alric também, mas duvido — ele não seria derrotado com tanta facilidade.

Preciso de tempo para interrogar os habitantes e me recuperar do combate. Brink está comigo há muito tempo — por favor, cuide dele para mim.

Quests.original:
- Remnant from Alric's Journal - 

The beauty of these sunken gardens shines through an age of dust and decay. Why did they fall to ruin? Could the same corruption that affects me now be responsible for this centuries old destruction?

The thought that this blight could be so ancient unnerves me, but if it consumes me I must go deep enough that I can never escape to do harm.

And, there is still hope. A fool's hope, but I cling to it.
Quests.translation:
- Trecho do Diário de Alric - 

A beleza destes jardins submersos reluz através de uma era de poeira e decadência. Por que caíram em ruínas? Poderia a mesma corrupção que me afeta agora ser responsável por esta destruição secular?

A ideia de que esta praga possa ser tão antiga me inquieta, mas se ela me consumir, devo ir fundo o bastante para que jamais possa escapar e causar dano.

E ainda há esperança. Uma esperança tola, mas me apego a ela.

Quests.original: The cycle is broken, Ordrak will not consume Torchlight as he did so many other civilizations.  And yet, the corruption remains, perhaps some part of his spirit lingers even now.\n\nI will remain here a while to ensure the town is safe.  I understand if you must continue your journey, but there are still unexplored chambers below.  We will have to deal with the twisted creatures there eventually, and the treasures you find may prove useful.
Quests.translation: O ciclo foi quebrado, Ordrak não consumirá Torchlight como fez com tantas outras civilizações. E, no entanto, a corrupção permanece; talvez alguma parte do espírito dele ainda perdure.\n\nFicarei aqui por algum tempo para garantir que a cidade esteja segura. Compreendo se você tiver que continuar sua jornada, mas ainda há câmaras inexploradas abaixo. Teremos que lidar com as criaturas deformadas de lá eventualmente, e os tesouros que você encontrar podem se mostrar úteis.

Quests.original: I've heard Syl tossing around the term "corruption" when discussing the Ember impurities.  I thought she was rash to say that without proper research, but now I believe her instinct was correct, the spirit in the Ember veins may be the force that mutates and drives the monsters below.\n\nI need more evidence to be sure.  The dwarves created an incredibly strong variety known as Adamant Ember.  Find me a sample and we'll learn the depth of this corruption.
Quests.translation: Ouvi Syl usar o termo "corrupção" ao discutir as impurezas do Âmbar. Achei que ela estava sendo precipitada ao dizer isso sem a devida pesquisa, mas agora acredito que o instinto dela estava certo: o espírito nos veios de Âmbar pode ser a força que muta e comanda os monstros abaixo.\n\nPreciso de mais evidências para ter certeza. Os anões criaram uma variedade incrivelmente resistente conhecida como Âmbar Adamantino. Encontre uma amostra para mim e descobriremos a profundidade desta corrupção.

Quests.original: When I was built, my creator and I would often see bards entertaining people on street corners, it's what inspired me to greatness!  Of course he doesn't see it that way, not yet.\n\nI recall a tale of a mighty fiend, |cFFFFBA00[DEFEAT1]|u, who slew countless warriors before disappearing into the wild.  I believe it's here, just |cFFFFBA00[DEFEAT1DEPTH]|u floors below Torchlight!  Isn't it thrilling?  Cut the beast down and I shall make heroes of us both!
Quests.translation: Quando fui construído, meu criador e eu costumávamos ver bardos entretendo as pessoas nas esquinas; foi isso que me inspirou para a grandeza! É claro que ele não vê dessa forma, ainda não.\n\nLembro-me de um conto sobre um monstro formidável, |cFFFFBA00[DEFEAT1]|u, que abateu incontáveis guerreiros antes de desaparecer na selva. Acredito que ele esteja aqui, apenas |cFFFFBA00[DEFEAT1DEPTH]|u andares abaixo de Torchlight! Não é empolgante? Derrube a fera e farei heróis de nós dois!

Quests.original:
These monster attacks are disrupting my work!

I am Vasman, a scholar of Ember.  I traveled to Torchlight to study the vast supply of Ember below, but these creatures make it impossible to obtain the samples I need.

Perhaps you have more courage than these miners.  If you brave the tunnels and bring me a sample of |cFFFFBA00Gleaming Ember|u, I will reward you well.  It should not be difficult, look for the Ember on the |cFFFFBA00first floor|u of the mine.
Quests.translation:
Estes ataques de monstros estão atrapalhando meu trabalho!

Eu sou Vasman, um estudioso do Âmbar. Viajei para Torchlight para estudar o vasto suprimento de Âmbar abaixo, mas estas criaturas tornam impossível obter as amostras de que preciso.

Talvez você tenha mais coragem do que estes mineradores. Se você desbravar os túneis e me trouxer uma amostra de |cFFFFBA00Âmbar Reluzente|u, recompensarei você muito bem. Não deve ser difícil: procure pelo Âmbar no |cFFFFBA00primeiro andar|u da mina.

Quests.original: The tremors are subsiding; my faith in you was well placed.  Have you encountered Master Alric again?  I will have to deal with him eventually - I cannot allow him to become a servant of darkness.\n\nWe are approaching the Ember Forge, but one final obstacle remains.  The Overseer's notes mention an ancient fortress infested with goblins, the hordes prevented him from ever reaching the Dwarven fortress itself.  Defeat the goblins and we'll be close to our goal.
Quests.translation: Os tremores estão diminuindo; minha confiança em você foi bem depositada. Você encontrou o Mestre Alric novamente? Terei que lidar com ele eventualmente — não posso permitir que ele se torne um servo da escuridão.\n\nEstamos nos aproximando da Forja de Âmbar, mas um obstáculo final permanece. As anotações do Feitor mencionam uma antiga fortaleza infestada de goblins; as hordas o impediram de alcançar a fortaleza dos anões propriamente dita. Derrote os goblins e estaremos perto do nosso objetivo.

Quests.original:
I can see it now.  You, weary from battle, your sword wavering in your hands.  |cFFFFBA00[DEFEAT1]|u, cackling with vile laughter, wielding a giant flaming club.  For a moment, you thought all was lost- but then, a rush of inspiration!

You remembered your mother, no, your love!  Yes, your far away love, and your promise to return!  In a rush of righteous fury, you struck the fiend down, and returned here victorious!

Ha, I will make you the hero of our age!
Quests.translation:
Posso ver tudo agora. Você, exausto do combate, sua espada vacilando em suas mãos. |cFFFFBA00[DEFEAT1]|u, gargalhando com riso vil, empunhando uma clava flamejante gigante. Por um instante, você pensou que tudo estava perdido — mas então, uma onda de inspiração!

Você se lembrou da sua mãe, não, do seu amor! Sim, do seu amor distante e da sua promessa de retornar! Em um ímpeto de justa fúria, você derrubou a criatura e retornou aqui vitorioso!

Há, farei de você o herói da nossa era!

Quests.original:
I'm a bit overwhelmed friend.  Brink is dead, my master is lost, and I feel responsible for your corruption as well.  Somehow the blighted Ember is fusing with your flesh, changing it - but at least the progress is slow.

I have some knowledge of the crypts below the mine.  The Overseer experimented with methods of purifying Ember, we may be able to use his knowledge to purge the corruption from you now.

Find the Overseers Library, his notes should be there.
Quests.translation:
Estou um pouco abalada, amigo. Brink está morto, meu mestre está perdido e me sinto responsável pela sua corrupção também. De alguma forma, o Âmbar amaldiçoado está se fundindo à sua carne, transformando-a — mas ao menos o processo é lento.

Tenho algum conhecimento sobre as criptas abaixo da mina. O Feitor realizou experimentos com métodos para purificar o Âmbar; talvez possamos usar o conhecimento dele para expurgar a corrupção de você agora.

Encontre a Biblioteca do Feitor, as anotações dele devem estar lá.

Quests.original:
I had heard of corruption in Torchlight's Ember, but I did not think it was so dangerous.  The Overseer dwelt amongst it for decades before it rotted his sanity away, why have you and Master Alric been affected so quickly?

What matters now is finding a cure.  Search the crypts below the mines for the Overseer's Library.  You may find the Overseer himself still guards it, you will need to find the strength to overcome him.

Beware of Alric, he is incredibly powerful.
Quests.translation:
Eu tinha ouvido falar da corrupção no Âmbar de Torchlight, mas não imaginava que fosse tão perigosa. O Feitor viveu em meio a ela por décadas antes que ela destruísse sua sanidade; por que você e o Mestre Alric foram afetados tão depressa?

O que importa agora é encontrar uma cura. Procure nas criptas abaixo das minas pela Biblioteca do Feitor. É possível que o próprio Feitor ainda a guarde; você precisará encontrar forças para superá-lo.

Cuidado com Alric, ele é incrivelmente poderoso.

Quests.original: Aha, the collection is complete!  This is a ghastly piece; the blight has consumed it completely.  I cannot wait to examine it, I can already hear it calling to me...\n\nYou know, for research purposes one can never have enough samples.  They're also quite valuable if one can find the right collector.  I'll be able to fund my research for years, and of course you'll have your share of the profit.  Most importantly, I'll have a chance to examine each sample, and learn secrets of the deep.
Quests.translation: Aha, a coleção está completa! Esta é uma peça medonha; a praga a consumiu por inteiro. Mal posso esperar para examiná-la, já consigo ouvi-la me chamar...\n\nSabe, para fins de pesquisa, nunca se têm amostras suficientes. Elas também são bastante valiosas se encontrarmos o colecionador certo. Poderei financiar minhas pesquisas por anos e, claro, você terá sua parte do lucro. Mais importante ainda: terei a chance de examinar cada amostra e aprender os segredos das profundezas.

Quests.original:
I can't believe Master Alric has been consumed so completely.  Ordrak is the cause, he has nested in the Ember for time beyond telling.  The twisted creatures in this mountain are a reflection of his heart; his dark spirit runs through their veins.

Master Alric is crafting Dark Ember, he brought me here to assist him.  I would have done so eventually, I can already hear Ordrak's voice calling to me.

You must destroy them, Alric and Ordrak both.  The Dark Ember is abomination we cannot allow.
Quests.translation:
Não posso acreditar que o Mestre Alric tenha sido consumido tão completamente. Ordrak é a causa: ele aninhou-se no Âmbar há tempos incontáveis. As criaturas deformadas nesta montanha são um reflexo de seu coração; seu espírito sombrio corre pelas veias delas.

O Mestre Alric está forjando o Âmbar Sombrio, ele me trouxe aqui para ajudá-lo. Eu teria feito isso no final das contas, pois já consigo ouvir a voz de Ordrak me chamando.

Você deve destruí-los, Alric e Ordrak, ambos. O Âmbar Sombrio é uma abominação que não podemos permitir.

Quests.original: Completion of the Dark Ember requires a powerful and willing sacrifice.  Among the servants here, only I am powerful enough to complete the ritual, but Ordrak will need my abilities to direct the Dark Ember's power.\n\nSyl is coming closer, she has grown stronger than I realized.  Strong enough to be useful, and she will be as receptive to Ordrak's will as I am.  Still, it will take time for her to understand.  My power wanes when I travel far from the core, I must draw her deep and find her alone.
Quests.translation: A conclusão do Âmbar Sombrio exige um sacrifício poderoso e voluntário. Entre os servos aqui, apenas eu sou poderoso o suficiente para completar o ritual, mas Ordrak precisará das minhas habilidades para direcionar o poder do Âmbar Sombrio.\n\nSyl está se aproximando, ela ficou mais forte do que imaginei. Forte o bastante para ser útil, e ela será tão receptiva à vontade de Ordrak quanto eu. Ainda assim, levará tempo para que compreenda. Meu poder enfraquece quando me afasto do núcleo; devo atraí-la para o fundo e encontrá-la sozinha.

Quests.original:
Ember is the essence of magic, the keystone of my art. For my kind, Torchlight is a beacon, a place of power, the largest cache of Ember ever found. I had heard nothing of the troubles afflicting that place.

I came only to serve my own ends, but I was lost as soon as I set foot in Torchlight.  The evil gathering there swallowed me, and I may never break free of it entirely.

The mines are dark, and below that, the blackness is impossible to describe. There is power beyond imagining, but the price is so very high.
Quests.translation:
O Âmbar é a essência da magia, a pedra angular da minha arte. Para a minha espécie, Torchlight é um farol, um lugar de poder, o maior depósito de Âmbar já encontrado. Eu não tinha ouvido nada sobre os problemas que afligiam aquele lugar.

Vim apenas para atender aos meus próprios interesses, mas me perdi assim que pus os pés em Torchlight. O mal que se acumulava ali me engoliu, e talvez eu nunca me liberte dele por completo.

As minas são escuras, e abaixo delas, a negrura é impossível de descrever. Há poder além da imaginação, mas o preço é muito alto.

Quests.original:
- Remnant from Alric's Journal - 

The miners chip their way down through the rock, unaware of the tombs below.  When they finally break through, I hope they are wise enough to flee, collapsing their tunnels behind them.

This vault was rightly sealed; it was an experiment as ill-fated as my own. Their ancestors are animated not with life, but with the same dark energy that flows through the Ember veins. Separating out the vileness is impossible.  Immortality lies forever beyond our reach.

I was a fool to think otherwise.
Quests.translation:
- Trecho do Diário de Alric - 

Os mineradores abrem caminho pela rocha, alheios às tumbas abaixo. Quando finalmente atravessarem, espero que sejam sábios o bastante para fugir, desmoronando seus túneis atrás de si.

Esta abóbada foi selada com razão; foi um experimento tão desventurado quanto o meu. Os ancestrais deles não estão animados pela vida, mas pela mesma energia sombria que flui pelos veios de Âmbar. Separar a vileza é impossível. A imortalidade repousa para sempre além do nosso alcance.

Fui um tolo ao pensar o contrário.

Quests.original:
The Dark Ember...  I do not yet understand it.  Does it have any purpose now that Ordrak has been destroyed?

Ordrak harnessed the energy of an entire mountain of Ember, but he could never leave the focal point of his web.  He was a prisoner of his own power, but was the Dark Ember meant to free him?  That would mean it had the power to channel energy directly from the focal point.

Imagine it, the power of an entire mountain of Ember in the palm of my hand!

I have so much more to learn, I may not be leaving Torchlight for quite some time...
Quests.translation:
O Âmbar Sombrio... Eu ainda não o compreendo. Terá ele algum propósito agora que Ordrak foi destruído?

Ordrak canalizava a energia de uma montanha inteira de Âmbar, mas nunca pôde deixar o ponto focal de sua teia. Ele era um prisioneiro de seu próprio poder, mas teria o Âmbar Sombrio sido feito para libertá-lo? Isso significaria que ele tinha o poder de canalizar energia diretamente do ponto focal.

Imagine só: o poder de uma montanha inteira de Âmbar na palma da minha mão!

Tenho muito mais a aprender, talvez eu não deixe Torchlight por um bom tempo...

Quests.original:
I am the great bard Trill, perhaps you've heard of me?  No?

That's the problem really; despite my astonishing talent, word of my ascendancy has not yet spread among the masses.  My ability is beyond question, but perhaps I have not yet found a tale truly worth telling.

Perhaps your heroic deeds will inspire me.  A beast known as |cFFFFBA00Varkaseer|u has been emerging at night to prowl about Torchlight, he is said to be a batlike creature with great power.  His lair is said to be on the third floor of the mine, slay him and I will immortalize your battle in verse!
Quests.translation:
Eu sou o grande bardo Trill, talvez você já tenha ouvido falar de mim? Não?

Esse é o problema, na verdade; apesar do meu talento assombroso, a notícia da minha ascensão ainda não se espalhou entre as massas. Minha habilidade está além de qualquer dúvida, mas talvez eu ainda não tenha encontrado um conto que realmente valha a pena ser contado.

Talvez seus feitos heroicos me inspirem. Uma fera conhecida como |cFFFFBA00Varkaseer|u tem emergido à noite para rondar Torchlight; dizem que é uma criatura parecida com um morcego, dotada de grande poder. Dizem que seu covil fica no terceiro andar da mina; mate-o e imortalizarei sua batalha em verso!

Quests.original:
- Remnant from Alric's Journal - 

I've arrived in Torchlight and begun my exploration of the tunnels below. These mines are vast and aglow with Ember; I've never seen so rich a vein. Miners labor to extract it, and take no heed of my warnings.

I cannot blame them; I too could not resist the pull of Ember.

This Ember is the same as that which afflicts me. The taint within it resonates with the corruption in my bones. I can feel it so clearly now, blight springs from the depths and flows up through the veins.

To purge myself of this evil, I must find the source.
Quests.translation:
- Trecho do Diário de Alric - 

Cheguei a Torchlight e iniciei minha exploração dos túneis abaixo. Estas minas são vastas e resplandecem com Âmbar; nunca vi um veio tão rico. Os mineradores labutam para extraí-lo e não dão ouvidos aos meus avisos.

Não posso culpá-los; eu também não consegui resistir à atração do Âmbar.

Este Âmbar é o mesmo que me aflige. A mancha em seu interior ressoa com a corrupção em meus ossos. Posso senti-la com tanta clareza agora: a praga brota das profundezas e sobe pelos veios.

Para me purificar deste mal, devo encontrar a fonte.

Quests.original:
- Remnant from Alric's Journal - 

Water pours from the ruins above and falls down into oblivion. These caverns are lost to time, primal. The Ember veins change as I descend- shifting colors, first hidden, then gleaming and glittering. It fascinates me now as it did when I was young.

Even the blight seems more pure here. My experiment may have succeeded if I had used Ember from deeper in the mountain, closer to the source. There is still the corruption of course, but with endless life that becomes a small matter.

Perhaps I will gain more here than I ever imagined.
Quests.translation:
- Trecho do Diário de Alric - 

A água jorra das ruínas acima e despenca no esquecimento. Estas cavernas estão perdidas no tempo, primordiais. Os veios de Âmbar mudam conforme desço — alternando cores, primeiro ocultos, depois cintilantes e reluzentes. Isso me fascina agora tanto quanto quando eu era jovem.

Até a praga parece mais pura aqui. Meu experimento poderia ter tido êxito se eu tivesse usado o Âmbar de mais fundo na montanha, mais perto da fonte. Ainda há a corrupção, é claro, mas com a vida eterna isso se torna algo menor.

Talvez eu consiga mais aqui do que jamais imaginei.

Quests.original:
Hey there stranger, welcome to Torchlight.  I'm Hatch, richest man in town.  Well, that's my plan anyhow.

I haven't worked out all the details yet, but the key is this here wand.  It opens a |cFFFFBA00portal|u to one particular spot, and I'm sure it must be full of treasure.  Problem is, it's also full of monsters, so I can't have a look for myself.

If you can handle the monsters and bring me the best |cFFFFBA00treasure|u you find in there, you can keep any gold and weapons for yourself.  Be careful though, I don't think any other portals will work in there.  What do you say?
Quests.translation:
Olá, estranho, bem-vindo a Torchlight. Eu sou Hatch, o homem mais rico da cidade. Bem, esse é o meu plano, de qualquer forma.

Ainda não acertei todos os detalhes, mas a chave é esta varinha aqui. Ela abre um |cFFFFBA00portal|u para um lugar específico, e tenho certeza de que deve estar cheio de tesouros. O problema é que também está cheio de monstros, então não posso ir conferir por mim mesmo.

Se você conseguir lidar com os monstros e me trazer o melhor |cFFFFBA00tesouro|u que encontrar lá dentro, poderá ficar com todo o ouro e as armas para si. Mas cuidado, acho que nenhum outro portal funcionará lá dentro. O que me diz?

Quests.original:
- Remnant from Alric's Journal - 

For hours I could feel the heat building. The rock beneath my feet grew warm, and sulfur burned in my nostrils. As I squeezed through the crack in the rock I expected to see lava, but still I was unprepared.

The glow of bubbling rock blinded my cavern adjusted eyes, and when my vision cleared I saw what I at first took to be a fortress. I now know it to be a prison, set upon pillars of rock in a molten sea.

Who could build such a thing? What could require such extreme incarceration? I am grateful that both prisoners and wardens have long since turned to dust.
Quests.translation:
- Trecho do Diário de Alric - 

Por horas pude sentir o calor aumentando. A rocha sob meus pés esquentava e o enxofre queimava minhas narinas. Ao me espremer pela fenda na rocha, esperava ver lava, mas ainda assim não estava preparado.

O brilho da rocha borbulhante cegou meus olhos acostumados à caverna, e quando minha visão clareou, vi o que a princípio considerei uma fortaleza. Agora sei que é uma prisão, erguida sobre pilares de rocha em um mar derretido.

Quem poderia construir tal coisa? O que exigiria um encarceramento tão extremo? Sou grato por prisioneiros e carcereiros há muito terem virado pó.

Quests.original:
- Remnant from Alric's Journal - 

The dwarves were consumed both from below and from within. Ordrak's minions assaulted the fortress, and his essence flowed through the Ember and turned them to his side. The remains of the battle are all around me, but my understanding comes from the Ember. He speaks to me through the veins, and I cannot shut my ears to his voice.

Despite his immense strength, Ordrak cannot leave the source of his immortality. His essence reaches out through the veins and corrupts without purpose.

Such power could transform the world, if only it were freed from this mountain.
Quests.translation:
- Trecho do Diário de Alric - 

Os anões foram consumidos tanto por baixo quanto por dentro. Os lacaios de Ordrak atacaram a fortaleza e sua essência fluiu pelo Âmbar, colocando-os ao seu lado. Os restos da batalha estão ao meu redor, mas minha compreensão vem do Âmbar. Ele fala comigo através dos veios e não posso fechar meus ouvidos à sua voz.

Apesar de sua imensa força, Ordrak não pode deixar a fonte de sua imortalidade. Sua essência se expande pelos veios e corrompe sem propósito.

Tal poder poderia transformar o mundo, se ao menos fosse libertado desta montanha.

Quests.original:
I have always been a wanderer. I have roamed these lands for as long as I can remember, but my blades always lead me back to conflict.

When I heard of the evils befalling Torchlight, I returned from the wilderness. Tales of madness - townsfolk slain, or missing... and a darkness, rising from the deep. It was inevitable that I was drawn to this place - my blades would not be still. So, I made the long journey.

I arrived at sunset, and while things at first seemed simple, I did not know then the shadows I would face, and the terrible power gathering far below the surface.

I would discover them in time...
Quests.translation:
Sempre fui um andarilho. Percorri estas terras desde que consigo me lembrar, mas minhas lâminas sempre me guiam de volta ao conflito.

Quando soube dos males que assolavam Torchlight, voltei das terras ermas. Relatos de loucura — habitantes assassinados ou desaparecidos... e uma escuridão que se ergue das profundezas. Era inevitável que eu fosse atraído para este lugar — minhas lâminas não ficariam em repouso. Por isso, fiz a longa jornada.

Cheguei ao pôr do sol e, embora as coisas a princípio parecessem simples, eu não sabia as sombras que enfrentaria e o terrível poder acumulando-se muito abaixo da superfície.

Eu os descobriria com o tempo...

Quests.original:
- Remnant from Alric's Journal - 

I have basked in his presence. The voice in the Ember is only a shadow of Ordrak's true glory. I find now that I have no desire other than to serve him, and to show his glory to the world.

My years of study are nothing to Ordrak's vast centuries dwelling in Ember, but still my knowledge sometimes surpasses his. His spirit infuses the Ember, it could be concentrated further, bringing his voice to the world.

Syl will see the potential. Together, we will free Ordrak from this mountain. Kingdoms will kneel before us, blinded by the radiance of our ascendancy! None will dare question the virtue of our art, or the power of Ordrak.
Quests.translation:
- Trecho do Diário de Alric - 

Banhei-me em sua presença. A voz no Âmbar é apenas uma sombra da verdadeira glória de Ordrak. Percebo agora que não tenho outro desejo senão servi-lo e mostrar sua glória ao mundo.

Meus anos de estudo nada são perante os vastos séculos de Ordrak habitando o Âmbar, mas ainda assim meu conhecimento por vezes supera o dele. Seu espírito permeia o Âmbar; poderia ser concentrado ainda mais, levando sua voz ao mundo.

Syl enxergará o potencial. Juntos, libertaremos Ordrak desta montanha. Reinos se ajoelharão diante de nós, cegados pelo esplendor de nossa ascensão! Ninguém ousará questionar a virtude de nossa arte ou o poder de Ordrak.

Globals.original: The Vanquisher is an expert marksman, and uses traps to confuse and debilitate her foes.
Globals.translation: The Vanquisher is an expert marksman, and uses traps to confuse and debilitate her foes.

Globals.original: Holding |cFFFFBA00[SHIFT]|u while attacking will allow you to remain in place during combat.
Globals.translation: Holding |cFFFFBA00[SHIFT]|u while attacking will allow you to remain in place during combat.

Globals.original: Use the mousewheel to zoom in and out - clicking the mousewheel button will reset your view.
Globals.translation: Use the mousewheel to zoom in and out - clicking the mousewheel button will reset your view.

Globals.original: The Alchemist channels the power of Ember to attack from afar and summon minions to his side.
Globals.translation: The Alchemist channels the power of Ember to attack from afar and summon minions to his side.

Globals.original: The Destroyer excels at melee combat and channels the power of his ancestors to smite his foes.
Globals.translation: The Destroyer excels at melee combat and channels the power of his ancestors to smite his foes.

Globals.original: Holding |cFFFFBA00[SHIFT]|u while clicking on an item will cause your pet to run and pick it up.
Globals.translation: Holding |cFFFFBA00[SHIFT]|u while clicking on an item will cause your pet to run and pick it up.

Globals.original: If you are dealing lots of |cFFFFBA00'Glancing Blows'|u, you probably need to upgrade your weapons.
Globals.translation: If you are dealing lots of |cFFFFBA00'Glancing Blows'|u, you probably need to upgrade your weapons.

Globals.original: Feed fish to your pet to turn them into creatures with varying abilities, strengths, and weaknesses.
Globals.translation: Feed fish to your pet to turn them into creatures with varying abilities, strengths, and weaknesses.

Globals.original: |cFFFFBA00Left-click|u on monsters to attack - hold the left mouse button down to continuously attack.
Globals.translation: |cFFFFBA00Left-click|u on monsters to attack - hold the left mouse button down to continuously attack.

Globals.original: Holding |cFFFFBA00[SHIFT]|u while clicking on an item in a Merchant screen will instantly sell or buy it.
Globals.translation: Holding |cFFFFBA00[SHIFT]|u while clicking on an item in a Merchant screen will instantly sell or buy it.

Globals.original: When you gain a level, remember to assign any points you may have earned to improve your player's abilities
Globals.translation: When you gain a level, remember to assign any points you may have earned to improve your player's abilities

Globals.original: Bind skills or spells to hotkeys by pressing F1-F12 when your cursor is over their icon in the skill foldout.
Globals.translation: Bind skills or spells to hotkeys by pressing F1-F12 when your cursor is over their icon in the skill foldout.

Globals.original: This is the |cFFFFBA00Enchantment interface|u. Place items here and pay a fee to receive random enchantments.
Globals.translation: This is the |cFFFFBA00Enchantment interface|u. Place items here and pay a fee to receive random enchantments.

Globals.original: Investing in Charm, Defensive, and Offensive Masteries improves the potency of any learned spells of those types.
Globals.translation: Investing in Charm, Defensive, and Offensive Masteries improves the potency of any learned spells of those types.

Globals.original: Press |cFFFFBA00A|u to toggle the |cFFFFBA00minimap|u, and use |cFFFFBA00[|u and |cFFFFBA00]|u to zoom in and out.
Globals.translation: Press |cFFFFBA00A|u to toggle the |cFFFFBA00minimap|u, and use |cFFFFBA00[|u and |cFFFFBA00]|u to zoom in and out.

Globals.original: Hold |cFFFFBA00[ALT]|u to see any items scattered on the ground, or toggle this view with the magnifying glass icon.
Globals.translation: Hold |cFFFFBA00[ALT]|u to see any items scattered on the ground, or toggle this view with the magnifying glass icon.

Globals.original: This is your |cFFFFBA00Shared Stash|u. Placing items here makes them accessible to other characters you have created.
Globals.translation: This is your |cFFFFBA00Shared Stash|u. Placing items here makes them accessible to other characters you have created.

Globals.original: Some equipment can only be used if you meet level or stat requirements. Requirements you don't currently meet are displayed in red.
Globals.translation: Some equipment can only be used if you meet level or stat requirements. Requirements you don't currently meet are displayed in red.

Globals.original: Hold |cFFFFBA00[Ctrl]|u and click on a learned spell to unlearn it - you'll lose the spell, but you will be able to learn a new one.
Globals.translation: Hold |cFFFFBA00[Ctrl]|u and click on a learned spell to unlearn it - you'll lose the spell, but you will be able to learn a new one.

Globals.original: If you find yourself dying too much, you should try to increase your armor. Higher value armor equipment reduces damage that monsters do to you.
Globals.translation: If you find yourself dying too much, you should try to increase your armor. Higher value armor equipment reduces damage that monsters do to you.

Globals.original: This is your |cFFFFBA00Stash|u. You can place items here for long-term storage.  If your inventory is getting full, offload some artifacts here.
Globals.translation: This is your |cFFFFBA00Stash|u. You can place items here for long-term storage.  If your inventory is getting full, offload some artifacts here.

Globals.original: You've gained a level! Click on the |cFFFFBA00Stats Up|u and |cFFFFBA00Skills Up|u buttons on either side of the screen to apply your newfound wisdom.
Globals.translation: You've gained a level! Click on the |cFFFFBA00Stats Up|u and |cFFFFBA00Skills Up|u buttons on either side of the screen to apply your newfound wisdom.

Globals.original: Elemental Resistances, like Fire Resistance, help reduce the elemental damage you take, as well as reducing the chance of harmful effects, like Burning.
Globals.translation: Elemental Resistances, like Fire Resistance, help reduce the elemental damage you take, as well as reducing the chance of harmful effects, like Burning.

Globals.original: Your |cFFFFBA00inventory is full|u. Either drop unwanted items, or give them to your pet by opening your pet's inventory and dragging items to empty slots.
Globals.translation: Your |cFFFFBA00inventory is full|u. Either drop unwanted items, or give them to your pet by opening your pet's inventory and dragging items to empty slots.

Globals.original: Send your pet to town to sell any excess items so that you can keep adventuring - click on the pet's |cFFFFBA00green merchant|u icon to send them on their way.
Globals.translation: Send your pet to town to sell any excess items so that you can keep adventuring - click on the pet's |cFFFFBA00green merchant|u icon to send them on their way.

Globals.original: |cFFFFBA00Left click|u to attack an enemy with your weapon. |cFFFFBA00Right Click|u to cast your readied |cFFFFBA00Skill|u, which is powerful, but consumes Mana.
Globals.translation: |cFFFFBA00Left click|u to attack an enemy with your weapon. |cFFFFBA00Right Click|u to cast your readied |cFFFFBA00Skill|u, which is powerful, but consumes Mana.

Globals.original: |cFFFFBA00Right-click|u to use your currently assigned |cFFFFBA00skill or spell|u.   You can also use |cFFFFBA00TAB|u to switch between it and an alternate skill, noted on the bottom menu.
Globals.translation: |cFFFFBA00Right-click|u to use your currently assigned |cFFFFBA00skill or spell|u.   You can also use |cFFFFBA00TAB|u to switch between it and an alternate skill, noted on the bottom menu.

Globals.original: This is the |cFFFFBA00Gambling interface|u. All of the merchant's items have unknown properties - you'll have to purchase them to find out what they do. Every item is guaranteed to be magical.
Globals.translation: This is the |cFFFFBA00Gambling interface|u. All of the merchant's items have unknown properties - you'll have to purchase them to find out what they do. Every item is guaranteed to be magical.

Globals.original: This is the |cFFFFBA00Transmutation interface|u. Place items here and attempt to combine them with the transmute button. There are many recipes for transmuting items, so try many combinations.
Globals.translation: This is the |cFFFFBA00Transmutation interface|u. Place items here and attempt to combine them with the transmute button. There are many recipes for transmuting items, so try many combinations.

Globals.original: You are trying to buy an item that you can not use yet, because either you are not high enough level, or don't meet the stat requirements. The requirements you don't meet are displayed in red text.
Globals.translation: You are trying to buy an item that you can not use yet, because either you are not high enough level, or don't meet the stat requirements. The requirements you don't meet are displayed in red text.

Globals.original: You have inscribed a |cFFFFBA00new spell|u to your spellbook; you may now cast it as you would any other skill.  Skills and spells can be mapped to the quickslots on the bottom of the screen by clicking on them.
Globals.translation: You have inscribed a |cFFFFBA00new spell|u to your spellbook; you may now cast it as you would any other skill.  Skills and spells can be mapped to the quickslots on the bottom of the screen by clicking on them.

Globals.original: You have |cFFFFBA00completed a quest|u. To receive your reward, travel back to the town and speak to the individual with a |cFFFFBA00?|u above their head. Use a |cFFFFBA00Town Portal Scroll|u to return directly to Torchlight.
Globals.translation: You have |cFFFFBA00completed a quest|u. To receive your reward, travel back to the town and speak to the individual with a |cFFFFBA00?|u above their head. Use a |cFFFFBA00Town Portal Scroll|u to return directly to Torchlight.

Globals.original: Welcome to the town of |cFFFFBA00Torchlight|u. Explore the area by |cFFFFBA00left-clicking to move around|u. Visit the denizens of the town to shop or find quests to perform. When you are ready, enter the mines to begin your journey!
Globals.translation: Welcome to the town of |cFFFFBA00Torchlight|u. Explore the area by |cFFFFBA00left-clicking to move around|u. Visit the denizens of the town to shop or find quests to perform. When you are ready, enter the mines to begin your journey!

Globals.original: You have discovered a |cFFFFBA00magical item|u! It is |cFFFFBA00unidentified|u, which means that its magic powers are undiscovered. Identify it by |cFFFFBA00right-clicking an Identify Scroll|u, then |cFFFFBA00left-clicking on the item|u.
Globals.translation: You have discovered a |cFFFFBA00magical item|u! It is |cFFFFBA00unidentified|u, which means that its magic powers are undiscovered. Identify it by |cFFFFBA00right-clicking an Identify Scroll|u, then |cFFFFBA00left-clicking on the item|u.

Globals.original: You have discovered a |cFFFFBA00socketable item|u! Socketable items imbue your weapons and armor with new magical properties when inserted.  If you discover an item with sockets, simply install the gemstone by |cFFFFBA00dropping it onto the item|u.
Globals.translation: You have discovered a |cFFFFBA00socketable item|u! Socketable items imbue your weapons and armor with new magical properties when inserted.  If you discover an item with sockets, simply install the gemstone by |cFFFFBA00dropping it onto the item|u.

Globals.original: You have new |cFFFFBA00Stat Points|u to distribute! Click the button next to each attribute to improve that aspect of your character. You also have new Skill Points that may be used to improve your character's abilities in the Skill Menu (press S).
Globals.translation: You have new |cFFFFBA00Stat Points|u to distribute! Click the button next to each attribute to improve that aspect of your character. You also have new Skill Points that may be used to improve your character's abilities in the Skill Menu (press S).

Globals.original: This is a |cFFFFBA00fishing hole|u. Click the hook icon when the circle goes red and you hear the splash of a bite.  Most of the fish you catch may be used to transform your pet into other creatures.  You may even catch special items from the depths.
Globals.translation: This is a |cFFFFBA00fishing hole|u. Click the hook icon when the circle goes red and you hear the splash of a bite.  Most of the fish you catch may be used to transform your pet into other creatures.  You may even catch special items from the depths.

Globals.original: Your |cFFFFBA00health is low|u. To heal yourself and avoid an untimely demise, |cFFFFBA00right-click on a health potion|u to drink it. You may also press the corresponding number key of any potion mapped to the quick-slot bar at the bottom of the screen.
Globals.translation: Your |cFFFFBA00health is low|u. To heal yourself and avoid an untimely demise, |cFFFFBA00right-click on a health potion|u to drink it. You may also press the corresponding number key of any potion mapped to the quick-slot bar at the bottom of the screen.

Globals.original: |cFFC0FFC0Green|u items have minor enchantments, |cFFC0C0FFBlue|u items are rare and powerful, |cFFFFCC3DGold|u items are unique and have more potent properties, and |cFFF54DFFPurple|u items are members of a Set, which gain additional abilities the more pieces you wear.
Globals.translation: |cFFC0FFC0Green|u items have minor enchantments, |cFFC0C0FFBlue|u items are rare and powerful, |cFFFFCC3DGold|u items are unique and have more potent properties, and |cFFF54DFFPurple|u items are members of a Set, which gain additional abilities the more pieces you wear.

Globals.original: Your |cFFFFBA00pet's inventory is full|u. You can |cFFFFBA00send your pet back to town|u by clicking on the |cFFFFBA00green arrow button|u in the pet interface. Your pet will depart for a short time to go sell the contents of it's inventory, then bring the profits back to you!
Globals.translation: Your |cFFFFBA00pet's inventory is full|u. You can |cFFFFBA00send your pet back to town|u by clicking on the |cFFFFBA00green arrow button|u in the pet interface. Your pet will depart for a short time to go sell the contents of it's inventory, then bring the profits back to you!

Globals.original: This is your |cFFFFBA00pet's inventory|u. Your pet can carry as many items as you can. You can also have your pet pick up items directly from the ground by holding |cFFFFBA00[SHIFT]|u and clicking on them. Your pet can also equip a limited selection of items to improve their abilities.
Globals.translation: This is your |cFFFFBA00pet's inventory|u. Your pet can carry as many items as you can. You can also have your pet pick up items directly from the ground by holding |cFFFFBA00[SHIFT]|u and clicking on them. Your pet can also equip a limited selection of items to improve their abilities.

Globals.original: Your |cFFFFBA00pet is fleeing|u - it will no longer attack and cannot pick up items for you. Pet health will slowly recover automatically, but you may heal your pet by dragging a potion to the pet bowl icon at the top left of the screen, or holding |cFFFFBA00[SHIFT]|u while right-clicking it.
Globals.translation: Your |cFFFFBA00pet is fleeing|u - it will no longer attack and cannot pick up items for you. Pet health will slowly recover automatically, but you may heal your pet by dragging a potion to the pet bowl icon at the top left of the screen, or holding |cFFFFBA00[SHIFT]|u while right-clicking it.

Globals.original: This is the |cFFFFBA00merchant interface|u - drag items from the left to the right to buy them, and vice-versa to sell.  You can perform an instantaneous transaction by holding |cFFFFBA00[SHIFT]|u while clicking on an item. You can also buy and sell from your pet's inventory, located in the bottom left.
Globals.translation: This is the |cFFFFBA00merchant interface|u - drag items from the left to the right to buy them, and vice-versa to sell.  You can perform an instantaneous transaction by holding |cFFFFBA00[SHIFT]|u while clicking on an item. You can also buy and sell from your pet's inventory, located in the bottom left.

Globals.original: Your |cFFFFBA00Mana is low|u. Mana is used to perform skills or cast spells.  Mana recharges over time, but for a quick boost, |cFFFFBA00drink a mana potion by right-clicking on it|u.  You may also press the corresponding number key of any potion mapped to the quick-slot bar at the bottom of the screen.
Globals.translation: Your |cFFFFBA00Mana is low|u. Mana is used to perform skills or cast spells.  Mana recharges over time, but for a quick boost, |cFFFFBA00drink a mana potion by right-clicking on it|u.  You may also press the corresponding number key of any potion mapped to the quick-slot bar at the bottom of the screen.

Globals.original: You have found a |cFFFFBA00spell scroll|u! In the Spells tab of your inventory, you can |cFFFFBA00right-click on the scroll|u or drop it into one of your spell slots to learn it, and you'll gain a new ability. You can also teach your pet spells by dropping them into the appropriate slots in their inventory.
Globals.translation: You have found a |cFFFFBA00spell scroll|u! In the Spells tab of your inventory, you can |cFFFFBA00right-click on the scroll|u or drop it into one of your spell slots to learn it, and you'll gain a new ability. You can also teach your pet spells by dropping them into the appropriate slots in their inventory.

Globals.original: This is your |cFFFFBA00inventory screen|u. Drag weapons and armor into the appropriate slots to equip them.  Drop items by dragging them into the play area.  Useable items may be activated by right-clicking on them. To use items on your pet, drag them to the pet bowl icon at the top left of the screen, or hold |cFFFFBA00[SHIFT]|u while right-clicking them.
Globals.translation: This is your |cFFFFBA00inventory screen|u. Drag weapons and armor into the appropriate slots to equip them.  Drop items by dragging them into the play area.  Useable items may be activated by right-clicking on them. To use items on your pet, drag them to the pet bowl icon at the top left of the screen, or hold |cFFFFBA00[SHIFT]|u while right-clicking them.
